chatMessage.p0: Who sent the message. User renders a right-aligned accent bubble capped at 80% of its parent; assistant fills the available parent width with left-aligned plain content. Also sets the entrance transform-origin.
chatMessage.p1: Message body. The assistant body fills its message/article width, so Markdown tables, code and other block content adapt to that width. Oversized content keeps its own horizontal scrolling. User messages render in the bubble; attachment-only messages omit the body.
chatMessage.p2: Timestamp shown before actions in the hover-revealed meta row. User-message only; ignored on assistant replies.
chatMessage.p3: Icon-only action buttons shown next to the timestamp in the hover-revealed meta row.
chatMessage.p4: Optional attachments rendered as square thumbnails above the bubble.
chatMessage.p5: Side length, in pixels, of each attachment thumbnail.
chatMessage.p6: Merged onto the outer motion wrapper for max-width or spacing adjustments.
chatMessage.latestProp: Shared latest-content navigation: a small outlined button with a down arrow, centered at the bottom. locale selects Chinese or English; label overrides the text; className only positions the overlay. The host shows it when away from the latest content, then scrolls and resumes following on click. CHAT_SCROLL_FOLLOW_THRESHOLD is 24px.
chatMessage.headerProp: Persistent identity above the message content. Compose ChatMessageAuthor here for a model logo, medium-weight model name and muted provider; it remains visible independently of actions.
chatMessage.actionsVisibilityProp: Set always to keep the action row visible on the latest reply. Auto reveals it on hover or focus, and keeps it visible on touch.
chatMessage.authorProp: model, logo and provider describe this response. The model name uses medium weight and the provider uses muted text. The logo is decorative; omit unavailable fields. Pass through ChatMessage.header, separately from the metric footer.
chatMessage.copyProp: Copies raw text and announces success or failure. labels overrides copy, copied and copyFailed.
